calculation.description: Three-session smoothing of the prior-day contrarian return, normalized by the instrument's trailing ten-session median relative high-low range. Inputs are lagged/observable at the decision date. Higher values indicate stronger expected rebound.

validation.regime_notes: Positive daily IC in all three regimes; strongest in 2020-2022 and weaker but positive in 2023-2024. Small 15-asset cross-section implies conservative uncertainty interpretation.
validation.provenance: Spearman cross-sectional IC, minimum 8 valid assets/date, 15 tradable benchmark instruments; forward returns computed after signal date.
